description: This Java enum class `ReportType` defines and manages valid report types for the reporting system in Apache Fineract. It provides methods for validation, conversion from string to enum, and ensures only predefined report types ('report' and 'parameter') are used, serving as a whitelist to prevent invalid entries or potential security issues.

classes.name: ReportType
classes.description: Enumeration of valid report types for whitelist validation, including utility methods for validation and conversion.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value associated with the report type.

methods.name: isValidType
methods.description: Checks whether a given string is a valid report type based on the predefined whitelist.

methods.name: fromValue
methods.description: Converts a string into the corresponding `ReportType` enum, throwing an exception if invalid.
